concepts.def: Buss (1989) cross-cultural study of 37 cultures: men prioritised youth, women prioritised resources, supporting evolutionary theory.
Thibaut and Kelley (1959): relationships maintained when rewards exceed costs above comparison level.
Hazan and Shaver (1987): infant attachment styles predict adult romantic patterns: secure, anxious, avoidant.
Darley and Latane (1968): diffusion of responsibility reduced helping; from 85% alone to 31% with four bystanders.
Batson (1981): empathy-altruism hypothesis claims empathy produces genuinely altruistic helping.
Sherif (1954) Robbers Cave: superordinate goals reduced inter-group hostility between Eagles and Rattlers.
